observations: Vintage-style sewing machine with a cream and brown/grey finish.
The machine is shown powered on, with the needle and presser foot illuminated by an internal light.
A red and white patterned fabric is being sewn on the machine.
The machine has a large dial on the right side for stitch selection.
A power cord is visible on the right side.
The brand name 'SCHNEIDER' is visible on the front panel in photo 0.
The machine appears to be in good cosmetic condition.

claims.evidence: The machine is shown powered on with an internal light, which is not typical for a brand new machine.
The machine is shown powered on, but there is no photo of it running or stitching.

risks.risk: The machine may not stitch or may have a faulty needle.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine stitching a piece of fabric.

risks.risk: The internal light may be a battery-powered LED rather than a mechanical light.
risks.proof: A photo of the machine powered off showing the needle and presser foot.

risks.risk: The machine may be missing a bobbin case or the bobbin may be broken.
risks.proof: A photo of the bobbin area and the bobbin case.

proof_requests: Video of the machine stitching a piece of fabric.
Photo of the bobbin area and the bobbin case.
Photo of the machine powered off to confirm the internal light is mechanical.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
